description: This file defines FastAPI routes for encoding and decoding management frames within a network management project. It includes request and response models using Pydantic, and route handler functions that depend on a management registry service to perform the encoding and decoding operations.

classes.name: EncodeRequest
classes.description: Request model for encoding a management frame, including frame type, header, and payload hex string.

classes.name: EncodeResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the encoded frame as a hex string.

classes.name: DecodeRequest
classes.description: Request model containing a hex-encoded frame for decoding.

classes.name: DecodeResponse
classes.description: Decoded frame fields, including frame type, header, and payload hex string.

methods.name: EncodeResponse encode_frame(req: EncodeRequest, reg: MGMTRegistryService = Depends(get_mgmt_service))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to encode a management frame, converting input data into an encoded hex string using the registry service.

methods.name: DecodeResponse decode_frame(req: DecodeRequest, reg: MGMTRegistryService = Depends(get_mgmt_service))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to decode a hex-encoded management frame into its constituent fields.

ctags.name: decode_frame
ctags.pattern: /^def decode_frame(req: DecodeRequest, reg: MGMTRegistryService = Depends(get_mgmt_service)) -> De/

ctags.name: encode_frame
ctags.pattern: /^def encode_frame(req: EncodeRequest, reg: MGMTRegistryService = Depends(get_mgmt_service)) -> En/

ctags.name: header
ctags.pattern: /^    header: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="Arbitrary header map.")$/

ctags.name: payload_hex
ctags.pattern: /^    payload_hex: str = Field(default="", description="Hex-encoded payload bytes.")$/
